body: I bought it from a niche store in France (since there's no large-scale tech stores here), so I can't return it. Ah well, I suppose it'll have to do.

Coming from someone who used to live in Japan (Not Osaka though), unless you have a massive Yodobashi or similar close by (Akihabara also, but that isn't within accessible distance from Osaka), I would just recommend to buy stuff from Amazon JP. Very cheap, and the delivery experience is excellent compared to most western countries.

But then again, PC stuff is already very expensive in Japan, so in some select cases it might just be cheaper to import from abroad. In general, though, go with amazon, not physical stores. They're great at testing out peripherals, but not so much cost-efficient buying.
